'''Gowrik Felrou''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] underboss of the [[Starbolts]] gang operating in the [[Free Zone]], a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] on [[Asylum]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] functioning as a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. Armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], wrist [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]], wrist shock device, and a [[jump pack]]-like device, Felrou fought in the gang war between the [[Blast Crew]] and the Starbolts<ref name="KOTFE" /> in [[3631 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> He was killed by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] and [[HK-55]], who were searching for a member of [[Koth Vortena's crew]], [[Tora]].<ref name="KOTFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gowrik Felrou appears in Chapter VI: Asylum in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] digital expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. While his affiliation is not explicitly stated in-game, Felrou's NPC is assigned to the faction ''hostile1'' along with the rest of the Starbolts in the area, while the Blast Crew members are ''hostile2''.
